notes.title: VR Support Officially Removed
notes.notes:
Due to all the issues with VR, I've decided to officially remove support for it. There were too many problems across too many headsets.

There were other VR gameplay issues as well like motion controllers not having enough buttons, awkward jetpack/jump controls, missing VR wrist HUD info, and blurry menus. I also don't own all the VR headsets on the market to test and debug with.
